bw-libs.js is a single minified bundle (built with esbuild) of:
  three.js r170 (MIT) - https://threejs.org  (Scene, WebGLRenderer, lights, materials, TextGeometry, Font)
  cannon-es 0.20.0 (MIT) - https://github.com/pmndrs/cannon-es  (3D rigid-body physics)
fredoka-font.js: Fredoka SemiBold (SIL Open Font License 1.1) outlines converted to the three.js typeface format.
Pinned and served from this folder so the page works offline and on GitHub Pages without a CDN.
